calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, min(calendar_date) mn, max(calendar_date) mx, count(*) n,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date x ON x.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE x.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND x.fiscal_period=2) lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date x ON x.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE x.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND x.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1,2)) distinct_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date x ON x.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE x.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND x.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1)) distinct_ids
FROM dim_date d WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
)
SELECT count(*) return_rows, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) distinct_ret_ids, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) distinct_sales_lines,
  sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date),
  sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned<=0 OR r.refund_net<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY store_id HAVING count(DISTINCT format)>1)) multi_format_stores
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN cohort c ON c.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cs.format, s.store_id, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
ref AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT format, (store_id=999 OR category='ZZ Test') AS excluded, count(*) n, SUM(net_amount) sold_net, SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net,0)) refunded_net,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net,0))/SUM(net_amount),2) rate
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ref r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2),
ref AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) rn, SUM(quantity_returned) rq FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) over_refunds, sum(CASE WHEN rq>quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM sold WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0) nonpos_sold
FROM sold JOIN ref USING (sales_line_id) WHERE rn > net_amount + 0.01
